LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_SearchTip: Filter entries on this branch by research name (including fallback names for unloaded MODs), event text, statistic names inside verified intervals, or undated trace names.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_DayRangeTip: Optional inclusive in-game day bounds (you may enter either end alone, e.g. 10 or 12.5). Single-day entries inside the range and verified intervals that overlap it are shown with their original span; undated traces are excluded while a day bound is set.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_InvalidDayRange: Enter non-negative numbers for start and end days (for example, 0, 10, or 12.5).
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_ReversedDayRange: Start day is later than end day. Enter a start day less than or equal to the end day.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_NoFilterMatches: No dated entries match the current search and day filter on this branch.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_UndatedHiddenByDayNotice: {0} undated traces are hidden while filtering by in-game days.
